# NeuralNg Accordion

Current component maturity: beta.

Import Accordion only from `@neural-ng/core/accordion`. Use standalone imports.

Canonical imports are `NeuralAccordion`, `NeuralAccordionPanel`,
`NeuralAccordionHeader`, and `NeuralAccordionContent`.

For object arrays, prefer `items` with `itemLabel`, `itemValue`,
`itemContent`, and optionally `itemDisabled`. `itemValue` must be a unique
string or number. Data content is plain text.

Invalid or missing data values fall back to the stable render index. Values
must remain unique; development mode warns about duplicates. Programmatic
`value` writes do not emit the user-only `panelChange` event.

For custom Angular markup, compose `neural-accordion-panel`,
`neural-accordion-header`, and `neural-accordion-content`. Never combine data
items and projected panels.

Bind `[(value)]`. Single mode uses `string | number | null`; `multiple` mode
uses an array. `panelChange` is optional and should only be used when the
interaction source or previous value is needed. Do not invent `onOpen`,
`onClose`, or `activeIndex` APIs.

Headers are native buttons with complete ARIA relationships and keyboard
navigation. Do not add custom key handlers around Accordion.

Use `unstyled` and typed `classes` for headless rendering. The default chevron
is CSS-only; do not require Neural Icons.

Canonical example:

```html
<neural-accordion accordionId="account" [(value)]="openPanel">
  <neural-accordion-panel value="profile">
    <neural-accordion-header>Profile</neural-accordion-header>
    <neural-accordion-content>Profile settings</neural-accordion-content>
  </neural-accordion-panel>
</neural-accordion>
```
